summary: Bush-backed north kerb, but no verge to pull off and no cars park there.
reasons: Kerb meets bush with no verge
No cars parked along this side

drivers.seclusion: Dense bushland on the van's side; nearest dwellings 20 m or more in the middle, but 6 m and 8 m at the ends.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; only a narrow grass strip between kerb and trees or bank, so a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through residential street linking up the hill; moderate local traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along the bush side in either image; no signs mapped.

flags: Narrow verge: kerb to trees, no room to pull fully off
Dwelling 6 m from the start and 8 m from the end of the stretch
Steep ground nearby, DEM shows 1-4% along the kerb
sun_shade: Tree canopy overhangs from the north and east; shaded in the morning, open to afternoon sun across the road.
cannot_judge: Exact verge width under the vegetation

best_section.where: Prospect Terrace north kerb, beside the bushland
